issues: 只有一排卡在浅黄底上滑，画面上半和下半大面积空白，没有任何排版
甩动的位移曲线没有和画面里其他元素产生关系，急刹的"刹"只能靠卡片自己读
落定后目标卡只放大 4%，卡面字仍是 16px 级，"要读内容"的落点读不清
底色偏黄、邻卡退暗不明显，主角不突出
changes: look 换成 paper 暖纸；右上加一只 150px 衬线机械滚轮索引计数器「Nº 02 / 10」，数位跟着长廊位置连续滚动（按转速竖向模糊、9→0 进位），甩时飞转、急刹时越转越慢、咔地停在 09
画面中线一根固定朱红播放头 + 随长廊走的刻度尺（每卡大刻度 + 等宽序号），甩动时刻度糊成一片，急刹时播放头卡进第 09 格
保留单条速度曲线积分（3f 起步 + 指数衰减，前 70% 路程 12f、后 30% 长尾 48f），按瞬时速度方向性拖影
落定：目标卡（高清纹理）抬起放大到 1.2×、阴影变深变虚，邻卡退到 45% 并后缩 4%，播放头下浮出朱红分区名 EFFICIENT MODELS
左上 PROJECT INDEX 眉题与右上计数器构成页眉，长廊居中，结尾帧是完整的索引海报
issuesEn: Just a row of cards sliding over a pale yellow ground, with the top and bottom halves of the frame empty and no typography
The whip's position curve drove nothing else on screen, so the brake could only be read from the cards themselves
After landing the target only grew 4% and its text stayed around 16px, so the 'land on content to read' payoff was unreadable
The ground skewed yellow and the neighbour dimming was faint, so the hero did not stand out
changesEn: Warm paper look; a 150px serif mechanical odometer 'No. 02 / 10' at top right rolls with the rail position (vertical blur by spin speed, real 9-to-0 carry), spinning during the whip, slowing on the brake and clicking to 09

A fixed vermilion playhead on the centre line plus a ruler that travels with the rail (major tick and mono index per card): the ticks smear during the whip and the playhead locks into slot 09 on the brake
The single integrated velocity curve is kept (3f ramp then exponential decay, 70% of the distance in 12f and a 48f tail), with directional blur by instantaneous speed
Landing: the hi-res target lifts to 1.2x with a deeper, softer shadow, neighbours drop to 45% and shrink 4%, and the vermilion section name EFFICIENT MODELS rises under the playhead
A PROJECT INDEX kicker at top left and the counter at top right form a header around the centred rail, so the end frame is a complete index poster
